card.name: Just before a drug's class description
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a short linking word right after a drug or class name, where a class label such as 'antagonist' or 'progestin component' comes next. Also the CCR5 and maraviroc area.

modes.label: Appositive after a drug name
modes.description: A comma, 'a' or 'an' after a drug name, just before its class is stated.
modes.example: fosaprepitant,<< a>> prodrug of aprepitant, is

modes.label: Agonist/antagonist slash
modes.description: The slash in 'estrogen agonist/antagonist' just before 'antagonist'.
modes.example: OSPHENA is an estrogen agonist<</>>antagonist which has agonistic effects

modes.label: Maraviroc and CCR5 antagonist
modes.description: Inside maraviroc or CCR5 just before 'antagonist' or the drug name.

card.plain: It fires where a drug name is about to be followed by what kind of drug it is, especially antagonists and hormone drugs.
